inputs.name: hand over from Containerization to Orchestration

output.level_0: Container builds fail silently and never reach the orchestration scheduler for execution.
output.level_1: No defined process exists to move containerized models into the orchestration environment.
output.level_2: Engineers manually push container images to the orchestrator after each successful build.
output.level_3: CI pipelines automatically deploy new containers to the orchestration layer upon validation.
output.level_4: Policy engines enforce compliance checks before any container is handed to orchestration.
